title: Persona 4 Revival Game Recasts Ryōtarō Dōjima
content:
The " Persona 4 Revival TV" livestream announced on Sunday that Ryōtarō Okiayu is voicing the character Ryōtarō Dōjima in Atlus ' Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game. Okiayu replaces the late Unshō Ishizuka , who originally voiced the character until his death in 2018. The stream also introduced the game's new feature "location episode."

The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC with Xbox Game Pass, and PC via Steam on February 18. The game will also launch for Nintendo Switch 2 on May 20. The remake will feature a new English voice cast.

Animation studio MAPPA is working on all the animated cutscenes in the game.

The original Persona 4 launched for PlayStation 2 in 2008. The game received a port for PlayStation Vita in 2011 under the title Persona 4 Golden. The franchise inspired several spin-off games, including Persona 4 Arena and its sequel Persona 4 Arena Ultimax , and Persona 4 : Dancing All Night .

Persona 3 Reload , the remake of Atlus ' Persona 3 RPG, launched for PS5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Windows and Steam in February 2024. The game was also available for Xbox Game Pass at launch. The game launched for Switch 2 in October 2025.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume" by Mori Tsubasa
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its twelfth ending, featuring the song “Aoi Yume” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 140-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the eleventh ending, featuring the song “Smile for…” by Ueto Aya . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!
author: Anime Corner

title: Ram Fights Lye in Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 18 Preview
content:
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 18 (Episode 84 overall) preview ahead of its September 23 2026 premiere. This will be the seventh episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc . The first part of the anime dominated our Spring 2026 awards , winning a total of 19 awards, while the anime ranked fifth in the latest weekly ranking after Episode 17. Studio WHITE FOX is animating.

You can watch the preview trailer for the seventeenth episode below.

ALSO READ: Re:ZERO Season 4 Director Reveals Unblurred Image of Rem Scene From Episode 13 Re:ZERO Looks Back at Season 1 Through 4 in New Lyric Video Featuring “Recollect” by Konomi Suzuki and Ashnikko

The title of the episode is “Ram,” and the synopsis is described: Upon arriving at the first floor, Emilia finds herself face-to-face with Volcanica, the Divine Dragon and one of the Three Great Heroes of Lugunica. With the Divine Dragon inexplicably repeating the same words over and over, the final “Trial” begins. Meanwhile, on the spiral staircase, Ram has gained the upper hand in her battle against her sworn enemy, Lye. Supporting the immense strain on the hornless Ram’s body is Subaru’s new Authority, “Cor Leonis.” However, realizing he is at a disadvantage, Lye leaps toward the defenseless, sleeping Rem…

title: The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic Anime Unveils 1st 2 Minutes, January Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Monshō Sakakibara 's Majutsu o Kiwamete Tabi ni Deta Tensei Elf, Moteamashita Jumyō de Ikeru Densetsu to Naru ( Tensei Elf for short) light novel series started streaming the first two minutes from the anime's first episode, and also announced its January 2027 premiere on Sunday.

ASMIK Ace describes the story:

Reincarnated as an elf— After his ordinary life comes to an abrupt end in a sudden accident, he is reincarnated as an elf with a lifespan of 1,000 years. Determined to live a life without regrets and leave behind proof of his existence, he sets out on a journey—where he reunites with a young girl whose life he once saved. An isekai fantasy depicting the journey of a reincarnated elf, marked by encounters and farewells.

The anime with the tentative English title The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic and With His Extra Lifespan Became a Living Legend stars Daiki Yamashita as Liese, and Hana Hishikawa as Minori.

Yuki Inaba ( KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World ; Parasyte -the maxim- , Shōnen Ashibe GO! GO! Goma-chan episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Palette , and is also in charge of series scripts.

Sakakibara launched the story on the Kakuyomu website in 2021. Starts Publishing released one volume of the novel with illustrations by Hatori Kyoka in 2022.

The manga adaptation by kanco launched on Starts Publishing 's Novema website in May 2023, under the company's isekai comic label Glast COMICS. The manga also serializes on Starts Publishing 's new manga website Manga Zegra. The manga's first compiled book volume shipped in March 2024, and the sixth volume shipped on June 26.
author: ANN

title: 'Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?' Announces Supporting Cast
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nazuna Miki 's Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ( So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ) manga announced supporting cast on Sunday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 5 at 10.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by broadcasts on BS11, Sun TV, and AT-X.

Cast Sandaime Hanzou: Junko Takeuchi ( Haigakura ) Nanadaime Hanzou: Mariya Ise ( Made in Abyss ) Rokudaime Masamune: Rin Mizuki ( Tomodachi no Imouto ga Ore ni dake Uzai ) Hachidaime Echigoya: Momoko Seto ( Mayonaka Heart Tune ) Shodai Hanzou: Yuuko Sanpei ( Oni no Hanayome ) Rokudaime Hanzou: Anna Nagase ( Koori no Jouheki ) Shodai Kinokuniya: Yukina Shutou ( Douse, Koishite Shimaunda. ) Yondaime Echigoya: Kentarou Tone ( Bakuman. ) Rokudaime Echigoya: Yumiri Hanamori ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai ) Nanadaime Echigoya: Yume Miyamoto ( SSSS.Gridman ) Yondaime Masamune: Natsumi Hioka ( Mitsuboshi Colors ) Godaime Masamune: Minami Takahashi ( Shokugeki no Souma ) Shodai Hokusai: Hikaru Tono ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! ) Sandaime Hokusai: Hiroyuki Yoshino ( Spy x Family )

Ryouta Kawahara ( Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu episode director) is helming the anime at Bakkka . Yuuichirou Momose ( Maou 2099 ) is handling the series composition and script. Hiroyuki Saita ( Cardfight!! Vanguard: overDress ) is designing the characters, while Takenoko Boy ( Tensei Akujo no Kuro Rekishi ending song arrangement) is composing the music.

Miki ( Botsuraku Yotei no Kizoku dakedo, Hima Datta kara Mahou wo Kiwametemita ) began serializing the fantasy manga in Tonari no Young Jump in February 2020, with illustrations by Tsukasa Araki . Shueisha released the 15th volume on September 17, with the 16th volume scheduled for an October 19 release.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in March 2022 and released the tenth volume on May 26.
author: MyAnimeList

title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? Anime Reveals More Cast, Character Visuals
content:
The staff for the television anime of writer Nazuna Miki and artist Tsukasa Araki 's So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ( Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ) manga unveiled 14 new cast members along with character visuals on Sunday.

Junko Takeuchi plays Sandaime Hanzо̄ (Hanzо̄ III).

Mariya Ise plays Nanadaime Hanzо̄ (Hanzо̄ VII).

Rin Mizuki plays Rokudaime Masamune (Masamune VI).

Momoko Seto plays Hachidaime Echigoya (Echigoya VIII).

Additional cast members include:

• Yūko Sanpei as Shodai Hanzо̄ (Hanzо̄ I)

• Anna Nagase as Rokudaime Hanzо̄ (Hanzо̄ VI)

• Yukina Shutо̄ as Shodai Kinokuniya (Kinokuniya I)

• Kentarō Tone as Yondaime Echigoya (Echigoya IV)

• Yumiri Hanamori as Rokudaime Echigoya (Echigoya VI)

• Yume Miyamoto as Nanadaime Echigoya (Echigoya VII)

• Natsumi Hioka as Yondaime Masamune (Masamune IV)

• Minami Takahashi as Godaime Masamune (Masamune V)

• Hikaru Tōno as Shodai Hokusai (Hokusai I)

• Hiroyuki Yoshino as Sandaime Hokusai (Hokusai III)

The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX channel on October 5 at 10:00 p.m. JST (9:00 a.m. EDT), and then on BS11 at 24:00 JST (effectively October 6 at 12 midnight), and on Sun TV at 24:30 (12:30 a.m.). The anime will also run on AT-X from October 7. The anime will stream on the ABEMA and Prime Video streaming services in Japan. The first episode will stream simultaneously with its broadcast at 10:00 p.m. JST, and the remaining episodes will stream one week ahead of its broadcast.

Crunchyroll will stream the series as it airs.

The anime stars:

• Kikunosuke Toya as Akira

• Yōko Hikasa as Karen

• Azusa Tachibana as Chloe

• Banjō Ginga as Simon

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Eirene

• M.A.O as Dike

• Wakana Kuramochi as Eunomia

• Natsuki Hanae as Albert

• Hiro Shimono as Isis

• Yukari Tamura as Tenchi Kaibyaku (literally, Creation of Heaven and Earth)

Ryūta Kawahara ( The Summer Hikaru Died , Orange , 86 , Blend S episode director) is directing the anime at BAKKKA . Yūichirō Momose ( So I'm a Spider, So What? , Africa Salaryman ) is in charge of the series scripts, Hiroyuki Saita ( Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez , Cardfight!! Vanguard overDress , Revue Starlight ) is designing the characters, Hiroto Morishita ( Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear , Wistoria: Wand and Sword two seasons) is the sound director, and Takenoko Boy ( The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess ending song arrangement, composition, and lyrics) is composing the music at INCS Toenter .

Sou performs the opening theme song "Hello," and musical artist AHUB performs the ending theme song "Chiisana Bokura" (Little Us).

Yen Press publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

The manga launched on Shueisha 's Tonari no Young Jump website in 2020. Shueisha published the manga's 15th volume on September 17. Yen Press published the 10th volume in English on May 26.

title: 'Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume' Anime's New Trailer Previews Opening Song
content:
The staff for Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume , the original television anime based on the Tetsudō Musume (Railway Girls) characters, started streaming the anime's pre-broadcast promotional video on Sunday. The video previews the previously announced opening theme song "GO! GO! RAILWAY!!" by artist Asaka .

The anime will premiere on October 8 at 12:00 a.m. JST (effectively, October 9 at midnight) on the Tokyo MX and BS Fuji channels. HIDIVE will stream the anime as it airs in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand. title: New Magic Knight Rayearth Anime's 2nd Main Trailer Reveals More Cast, Theme Songs
content:
The KyoMAF special stage for the new anime of CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth manga on Sunday revealed the second main promotional video and additional cast members for the series. The video also reveals and previews the opening theme song "Otome no Tsurugi" (A Young Lady's Sword) by Toaka , and the ending theme song "Hoshiakari" (Starlight) by Yurina Kawaguchi .

The newly announced cast members are:

Mamiko Noto as Alcione

Ayumu Murase as Ascot

Hitomi Ueda as Caldina

Hiroki Yasumoto as Lafarga

The event also revealed the anime will air for two consecutive cours (quarter of a year) for a half-year run.

The anime will debut on October 7 in the "IMAnimation W" programming block on TV Asahi and affiliated channels at 11:45 p.m. (10:45 a.m. EDT).

The anime will star:

• Ayane Sakura as Hikaru Shidō

• Rumi Ōkubo as Umi Ryūzaki

• Rie Takahashi as Fū Hōōji

• Saori Hayami as Emeraude

• Yūki Ono as Zagato

• Mika Kikuchi as Mokona

• Yūki Kaji as Clef

• Emiri Katō as Presea

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Ferio

Yui Miura (episode director for Ninja Kamui , Bullet/Bullet ) is making his series directorial debut with the anime, and E&H production is producing the anime. Shigeru Murakoshi ( Zombie Land Saga , Ninja Kamui , Apocalypse Hotel ) is in charge of the series scripts. Satomi Watabe ( Escha Chron , Aikatsu Friends! ) is designing the characters. Yuki Kajiura , Takumi Ozawa , and Shiho Terada are composing the music. UNLIMITED PRODUCE by TMS is producing the project.

Additional staff members include:

• Assistant Director: Takayuki Sano

• Chief Animation Director: Satomi Watabe

• Rune God Design/Rune God Mechanic Director: Hiroki Mutaguchi

• Art Director: Kazumaru Ando

• Color Key Artist: Chiho Nakamura

• 3D Supervision: Tomohiko Kan

• Compositing Director of Photography: Hitoshi Tamura

• Editing: Keisuke Yanagi

• Sound Director: Shūhei Abe

• Creative Producer: Sunghoo Park

Magic Knight Rayearth centers on three high school girls named Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu. On a class field trip to Tokyo Tower, they are magically transported into the fantasy world of Cephiro. They are immediately greeted by the mage Clef, who tells them that the world is dying after the priest Zagato kidnapped Princess Emeraude, whose prayers maintain the state of the world. Without her singing, Cephiro is on the brink of collapse. Imbued with magical powers as the Magic Knights, Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu must learn how to work together to survive and save Cephiro.

The creative circle CLAMP serialized the Magic Knight Rayearth manga in Kodansha 's Nakayoshi magazine from 1993 to 1996 with six volumes. The manga inspired two television anime seasons, the first running from October 1994 to March 1995, and the second season, titled Magic Knight Rayearth 2 , running from April to November 1995. The manga also inspired a three-episode 1997 original video anime project simply titled Rayearth , featuring an alternate retelling of the story.

Media Blasters first released the television anime on VHS and DVD in the United States. Discotek Media licensed the anime in 2014, and released it as a complete collection on DVD and Blu-ray Disc in 2017. (The release did not include the Rayearth OVA series.)

title: Magic Knight Rayearth 2026 Unveils New Trailer Featuring Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content:
The upcoming Magic Knight Rayearth anime remake unveiled a new trailer that features the opening and ending theme songs and four additional cast members. Toaka performs the opening theme song “Otome no Ken” and the ending theme song “Seira” is performed by Yurina Kawaguchi. E&H production is animating the series, slated to premiere on October 7, 2026.

The voice cast includes:

• Ayane Sakura as Hikaru Shidou

• Rumi Okubo as Umi Ryuuzaki

• Rie Takahashi as Fuu Hououji

• Saori Hayami as Emeraude

• Yuki Ono as Zagato

• Mika Kikuchi as Mokona

• Yuki Kaji as Clef

• Emiri Kato as Presea

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Ferio

• Mamiko Noto as Alcyone (NEW)

• Ayumu Murase as Ascot (NEW)

• Hitomi Ueda as Caldina (NEW)

• Hiroki Yasumoto Lafarga (NEW)

Yui Miura is directing the anime, with Shigeru Murakoshi handling the series composition. Satomi Watanabe handles character design, while Yuki Kajiura, Takumi Ozawa, and Shiho Terada compose the music. Magic Knight Rayearth is a Japanese manga series created by CLAMP . It was serialized in the Nakayoshi magazine from November 1993 to February 1995. A sequel was serialized in the same manga magazine from March 1995 to April 1996. Kodansha published both series in a total of 6 volumes, and they describe it as follows: While on a field trip to Tokyo Tower, three teenage girls cross a magical portal and are transported to another world called Cefiro. There they are summoned through the last remaining strength of the Princess Emeraude, who believes the trio will become the magic knights who will save her, as prophesied by legend.
author: Anime Corner
